"""Rebuild the actual single-GPU serial gate fix; unchanged fixtures retain prior proof."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_serial_gate_build_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    old_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-full-build-root-v5/record.json'
    old = json.loads(old_path.read_text())
    assert old['passed'] and old['complete'] and not old['active']
    model = json.loads((B / 'main-phase-cache-model-lifetime-root-v1/record.json').read_text())
    assert not model['active'] and not model['passed']
    process = next(c for c in model['commands'] if c['label'] == 'engine-phase-lifetime')
    assert process['direct_child_reaped'] and process['session_empty'] and not process['survivors']
    assert not process['cleanup'] and process['exit_code'] == 1
    assert m.identity(process['pid']) is None
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    env = dict(old['environment'])
    pins = {name: m.sha(W / name) for name in old['source_pins']}
    changed = {name for name, sha in old['source_pins'].items() if pins[name] != sha}
    assert changed == {'src/program/generate.cpp', 'docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.ja.md', 'docs/PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.md'}
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=env, source_pins=pins, prior_build=dict(path=str(old_path), sha256=m.sha(old_path)),
             changed_source=sorted(changed), compiler_affected_files=['src/program/generate.cpp'],
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, production_admitted=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv):
        print('OWNED SERIAL GATE BUILD ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=1200, cpu=12000, rss_cap=24 << 30,
                            text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '54385d6f975a13df5da87f489614d0b729d2aba6'
        assert run('changed-source', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']) == 'src/program/generate.cpp'
        for mode in ('free', 'contrib-llvm'):
            folder = W / 'build' / mode
            run('build-' + mode, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(folder), '--parallel', '4',
                                '--target', 'strata', 'phase_cache_owner_test', 'phase_cache_vmm_test'])
            assert m.sha(folder / 'phase_cache_owner_test') == old[mode]['host_fixture_sha256']
            assert m.sha(folder / 'phase_cache_vmm_test') == old[mode]['vmm_fixture_sha256']
            r[mode] = dict(binary_sha256=m.sha(folder / 'strata'), built=True,
                           host_fixture_sha256=old[mode]['host_fixture_sha256'],
                           vmm_fixture_sha256=old[mode]['vmm_fixture_sha256'],
                           unchanged_host_vmm_fixture=True)
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in pins.items())
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, scope='free/contrib full engine incremental compilation of serial admission guard; unchanged CPU/actual VMM proof remains inherited')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({key: r.get(key) for key in ('passed', 'error', 'scope')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
